note: Protocol reference only. The CLI takes these as flags; this file is not executed. Results from the executed run are in results/heldout-64.json and docs/hp-handoff.md.

evaluation.surface_rng: explicit per-method seed; cnf and plain_post share the corrected-sampling offset
evaluation.matched_ddim: one seed per object, shared across generated arms

metrics.constraints: anchor value/gradient abs residual, solve rank/condition/residual
metrics.geometry: full and hidden Chamfer (squared normalized length units)

guarantee_boundary: 128 equalities hold for the continuous corrected field at 32 points; no global SDF/topology/mesh-vertex guarantee
